origin: Original C lookup defaults, type selection, small/ordinary/contiguous-MB constructors and selected scanning kernels. Test driver supplies the nucleotide orchestration branch, following lookup_wrap.c; it does not call full LookupTableWrapInit_MT or a complete search. Raw seed pairs and every batch/restart offset are compared. Includes real default size thresholds through 800001 residues, large-offset masked inputs, empty markers and subjects of length 1..129.
